foundations.motion: Partial: Material duration and easing tokens, color and corner transitions, reduced motion and a state change transition on button, checkbox, radio, switch, slider, segmented button and chip (the tab indicator declares it but is inserted on selection, so it appears at once); springs, layout and position animation, hover and press opacity, enter and exit animation, native OS reduced-motion query and exact emphasized path easing pending; shape morphing per component state pending
